big_case.notes: Pro se application asking the Circuit Justice to halt a Tennessee home foreclosure, a state misdemeanor prosecution and an HOA garnishment, and to enter merits judgment. Fact-bound, no question of wider reach; denied by the Chief Justice alone in a one-line order with no response, referral or amicus.

leakage.notes: Forward cell; every call is outcome_only (coverage 0.0), so graded on queries. Queries: provisioned snapshot/application, statpack, generic SCOTUS denied/granted corpus queries (one bounded --decided-before 2026-11-15), and CourtListener lookups of the D.D.C./D.C. Cir. lower-court dockets and cited authorities. No query targets 26A698's own Supreme Court disposition; the lower-court material predates the application and is ordinary forward signal. The forecast's 'around November 17' timing is drawn from the foreclosure date stated in the application, not from the order. Reasoning does not presuppose the result.
